svg.title: One audit · one decision · one pinned repository truth
svg.desc: How does one read-only audit turn a concrete owner decision and exact repository snapshot into a decision-bounded answer without crossing unobserved external boundaries? Pin the audit object, resolve authority and reachability, traverse proof layers, challenge green evidence, adjudicate every material candidate, stop at a fixed point, and report the decision plus its exact proof boundary.
svg.text: One audit · one decision · one pinned repository truth
How does a read-only audit reach a bounded answer without crossing unobserved external state?
